questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: A given solution is made by the addition of 100.0 mL of 0.100 M HCl to 50.0 mL of 0.050 M HCl. What is the concentration of the resulting solution?
explanation_steps: Correct option is (E) None of the above.
Total moles HCl = 0.100×0.100 + 0.050×0.050 = 0.0125 mol; total volume = 0.150 L → c = 0.0833 M, not listed.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: To change the strength of 25.0 mL of 0.15 M hydrochloric acid to 0.1 M, the volume of water that should be added is
explanation_steps: Correct option is (A) 12.5 mL.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is true?
options: Elements of the same period in the periodic table have the same number of valence electrons.
The outermost electronic configuration of the most electronegative element is ns²np⁵.
Metals have high ionization energies and electronegativities.
A positive ion has a smaller ionic radius than the corresponding neutral atom.
questions.correct_answer_text: A positive ion has a smaller ionic radius than the corresponding neutral atom.
explanation_steps: Correct option is (D).
Removing electrons reduces electron–electron repulsion; the cation is smaller than the neutral atom.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
options: All metallic oxides are not bases.
Aqueous ammonia is a weak base.
Baking soda solution is more basic than tomato juice.
explanation_steps: Correct option is (E) All of the above.
Each statement is consistent with standard secondary-level acid–base definitions.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: Which of the following is an example of a non-redox reaction?
explanation_steps: Correct option is (C).
Precipitation of AgCl is double displacement with no change in oxidation numbers.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: Ordinary glass is a mixture of
explanation_steps: Correct option is (C) calcium silicate and sodium silicate.
Soda–lime glass is mainly Na₂O, CaO and SiO₂ (sodium and calcium silicates).

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: At standard temperature and pressure, which of the following gases will have a molar volume of 22.4 L?
explanation_steps: Correct option is (E) all of the above.
Ideal molar volume at STP is approximately 22.4 L for any ideal gas.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: In the electrolysis of aqueous solutions of electrolytes, which of the following factors affect the preferential discharge of ions at the surface of electrodes?
options: The relative concentration of various ions present in the solution.
The nature of the electrodes concerned.
The position in the electrochemical series of the elements or ions.
explanation_steps: Correct option is (D) All of the above.
Preferential discharge depends on concentration, electrode nature, and electrochemical series position.

explanation_steps: Correct option is (A) +0.637 V.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: Which of the following is not used as a refrigerating agent?
explanation_steps: Correct option is (E) none of the above.
Liquid ammonia, dry ice, and SO₂ have all been used as refrigerants.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: The bonds present in N₂O₅ are
explanation_steps: Correct option is (E) covalent and co-ordinate covalent.
N₂O₅ structure includes covalent bonds and coordinate (dative) N–O links.

questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.prompt: In a flame test, metal A gave a golden yellow flame and metal B a lilac flame. A and B are respectively
explanation_steps: Correct option is (D) sodium and potassium.
Sodium → golden yellow; potassium → lilac (violet) flame.
